name: Can flooring be installed right away in a foreclosed property, or does it need prep first?

mainEntity.name: Can flooring be installed right away in a foreclosed property, or does it need prep first?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can usually move forward with installation once the property is secured, cleaned out, and any active water or structural problems are addressed. If the home has been vacant for a while, the flooring job may need prep work first, such as debris removal, moisture repair, or subfloor leveling.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most foreclosed homes need prep before new flooring goes in. Cleaning, moisture checks, and subfloor repairs often come before installation.
